description: Implement an automated cron job system that processes partner payouts after they reach a 90-day age threshold. The system should automatically withdraw payouts to partners' financial accounts, enforce minimum withdrawal amounts, apply appropriate fees, and send notifications about the automated withdrawals.
functional_requirements: Create a cron job that runs daily to identify payouts that have been aged for 90+ days and are eligible for automatic withdrawal
Implement minimum withdrawal amount enforcement ($10 USD) with a $0.50 fee for payouts below this threshold
Add stablecoin payout support with a 0.5% transaction fee for automated withdrawals
Build a force withdrawal capability that allows manual triggering of automated withdrawals for specific partner payouts
Update email notification templates to inform partners about automated withdrawals, including details about fees and transaction amounts
